sanskrit_verse: उग्रः पारशवश्चैव निषादश्चानुलोमतः। उत्तमेभ्यस्त्रयस्त्रिभ्यः शूद्रापुत्राः प्रकीर्तिताः॥
transliteration: ugraḥ pāraśavaś caiva niṣādaś cānulomataḥ | uttamebhyastrayas tribhyaḥ śūdrāputrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: From the mixture of higher varnas with Shudra women, three degraded offspring are born: Ugra, Parashava, and Nishada; these are declared as Shudra-born and exist outside the Varna order due to directional misalignment in procreation.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with cosmic order, not biological lineage alone
Causation is determined by intentional directionality in social creation
Capacity-based responsibility arises from conscious participation in dharma
Restoration logic requires realignment of roles based on evolved consciousness
executable_legal_axioms: IF progeny results from union violating directional Varna flow THEN classification shall default to base Varna until conscious re-elevation occurs
IF individual demonstrates evolved consciousness THEN prior birth-based limitations become non-operative
IF societal role causes disruption THEN mandatory completion process initiated through capacity-building protocols
IF alignment with dharma is restored THEN status elevation permitted without punitive review
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating caste-related disputes, the Supreme Court must recognize that birth-based classifications yield only provisional statuses subject to conscious evolution. Legal standing shall not be permanently bound by ancestral misalignments but must reflect current levels of dharmonic integration and societal contribution.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana establishes that social disorder originates from directional misalignment, not inherent fault. Anupurvasah shows that consequences unfold sequentially through disordered action. Responsibility lies in restoring correct orientation rather than imposing punitive measures. Truth-exposure itself resolves karmic entanglement when aligned with consciousness expansion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate consciousness assessment to determine present alignment level
Assign completion processes involving skill development and service learning
Reintegrate individual into appropriate functional role upon demonstrated readiness
Establish mentorship pathways for accelerated spiritual-social realignment
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores truth through consciousness elevation. No punishment exists where awareness awakens. Reality aligns with dharma when judgment yields to awakening.
